37838730.notes:
Re-recorded for the 20th anniversary.
Track A3 is written in uncontracted braille, its transcription is "For Stevie Wonders Eyes Only".
"Liquor & Love Lost" uses its demo name "Dragon Slaying" for the re-recorded version.
"Dehumanized" is a new song, not featured on the original album.

Housed in a gatefold with embossed cover art and art inlay.
Comes in a custom inner sleeve, and with a 12-page booklet and a double-sided poster.

The hype sticker was marketed to include the band name, album title, and tracklist on it but was misprinted to be very hard to read. While the band name and "Side A." / "Side B." are legible, the album title is very faint, and the tracklist is borderline illegible unless backlit and held at the right angle.

The catalog number appears on the spine, back cover, poster, inner sleeve, and center label.
Tracklist appears on the center labels.
Side A runouts contain mirrored characters: "2-".
Side B runouts contain mirrored characters: "2=".
Lacquer Cut At / Lacquer Cut By credits are credited as "Vinyl cut by Naweed At Whitfield Mastering, London" in the booklet.

38020071.notes:
Issued in a single-pocket jacket with a 2-sided printed insert featuring lyrics, credits, and band photography. Pressed on clear vinyl.

Jacket back cover incorrectly lists "Ataraxia" as track B1. The physical vinyl and official label webstore tracklist both feature "Ataraxia" as track A5 and "Ultraviolence" as track B1. The double-sided lyric insert groups all Side A lyrics on one side (ending with "Ataraxia") and Side B lyrics on the other side (beginning with "Ultraviolence").

Hype sticker on shrink wrap reads:
"Allt
ATARAXIA
Sophomore album of Swedish progressive metalcore trailblazers Allt
Clear LP"

Insert credits lineup as "ALLT IS: Olle Nordström, Adam Björk, Viktor Florman, Robin Malmgren".
